spec: This module is a part of the FSM for controlling the shift register, we want the ability to enable the shift register for exactly 4 clock cycles whenever the proper bit pattern is detected. Whenever the FSM is reset, assert shift_ena for 4 cycles, then 0 forever (until reset). Reset should be active high synchronous.
module_header:
module top_module(
	input clk,
	input reset,
	output shift_ena);
